moving_day.heading: Your moving day, step by step
moving_day.lead: From booking to the last box. Here is what we do, and what you do, at each step.

steps.name: Book
steps.we: Reply to your quote request with a price and a day.
steps.you: Tell us what you are moving and where.

steps.name: Pack
steps.we: Bring boxes and packing on the day, if you ask for them.
steps.you: Pack what you can, and label the boxes by room.

steps.name: Load
steps.we: Carry everything out and load the van with care.
steps.you: Show us what goes and what stays.

steps.name: Drive
steps.we: Drive your things to the new place.
steps.you: Meet us there, or leave us the keys.

steps.name: Unload
steps.we: Carry each box to the room on its label.
steps.you: Tell us where the big things go.

steps.name: Done
steps.we: Take away the packing, if you want us to.
